subject.title: Feature Request: cron.defaults.delivery config for default delivery target

question: Should OpenClaw add a global primary `cron.defaults.delivery` recipient, and should that default be copied into newly created jobs or resolved dynamically when each job runs?
rationale: This choice sets durable recipient authority and upgrade behavior across channels and accounts; source and documentation show supported per-job and captured-session routes, but no existing contract chooses between creation-time inheritance and runtime retargeting.

options.title: Creation-time default with explicit storage
options.body: Apply a validated default only when a new job omits delivery, store the resolved route on that job, and preserve existing jobs unchanged.

options.title: Runtime-resolved global default
options.body: Resolve omitted job routes from current config at execution time, accepting that a configuration edit can retarget future runs of existing jobs.

options.title: Keep per-job routes only
options.body: Retain explicit CLI/API delivery fields and captured active-chat targets without adding another persisted configuration surface.

recommendation.title: Creation-time default with explicit storage
recommendation.body: Apply a validated default only when a new job omits delivery, store the resolved route on that job, and preserve existing jobs unchanged.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent cron/configuration work and the prior issue review make steipete the strongest available decision-routing candidate.
